messages.text: Is there anything else I can do to get a refund before it’s delivered?

The refund process only covers delivered orders, so there isn’t a refund I can request before delivery. You could contact a staff member about cancelling or changing the delivery; that’s outside this refund process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
